mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 215 signals persistent inflation that triggers anticipated monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days when the threshold is breached.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 215) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising UNRATE and declining PAYEMS signal labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns when the correlation with S&P 500 returns is below -0.05 in a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, high HOUST above 1000 units indicates overbuilding and potential economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST exceeds 1000 units.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO falling below 110 signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the threshold is breached.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 110 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE exceeding 5.0% indicates economic weakness that typically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS above 380,000 signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 380,000 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 1000 units indicates strong housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sector-driven economic momentum.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1000 units over a 3-year rolling window.
